name: social-short-form-writer
description: Convert blog posts to native Instagram + TikTok + Threads captions optimized for 2026 algorithms with Hook Quality Gate (5-test rubric) enforcement. 3 skills: /instagram-gen (4:5 photo carousel, 5-hashtag hardcap since Dec 2025, hook-first ≤125 chars, default short-form 100-300 chars per Socialinsider 9M+ posts study, NO link-in-caption, optional text_only_caption for FB cross-post reuse), /tiktok-gen (9:16 photo-mode + video, default 80-150 chars per TTS Vibes +21% likes engagement data, first 80-100 chars critical for search index + preview cutoff, 5-8 hashtags, link-in-caption OK, distinct title ≤90 chars), and /threads-gen (≤500 char hard cap with 280-450 sweet spot for thought-leadership dwell, 0-3 hashtag minimal-culture cap, ≤140 char preview-cut hook, Pro-but-conversational tone). All 3 skills author Bahasa Indonesia by default (Indonesian audience target — Gen Z + founder/dev community); EN tech terms OK as cultural shorthand. Hook Quality Gate (v0.5.0+): first sentence MUST pass 5 tests — standalone-readable, specific, curiosity-gap, native voice, payoff within preview window. Pure content generation — emits draft JSON for an admin panel to consume. Pairs with linkedin-post-writer (English long-form text + carousel routing for US hiring manager + B2B reach) and ai-image-carousel-prompt-gen (universal slide image engine). Facebook Page caption authoring handled by consuming backend (FB text reuses /instagram-gen text_only_caption; FB carousel reuses /instagram-gen output).
